artisans.name: Parvati Bai Deshpande
artisans.bio: Master Kasuti artisan practicing the traditional Gavanti and Murgi double-running stitches passed down 4 generations from the Chalukyan era. She leads a self-help cooperative of 35 women embroiders in Dharwad.

artisans.name: Ganesh Devadiga
artisans.bio: Specialist in sacred coastal Beedu (palm leaf and wild cane lattice) weaving traditionally used in Daiva Aradhane shrines and coastal canopy architecture. He preserves 800-year-old coastal weaving geometry.

artisans.name: Kavita Naik
artisans.bio: Award-winning coastal artisan transforming discarded coconut shells, weathered driftwood, and natural sea-glass into intricate temple sculptures, lamps, and acoustic rhythm instruments.
